We provide a synthetic IJCAI proceedings abstract for regression testing. It mirrors the real DOM shape observed on ijcai.org/proceedings/{2017,2019,2023,2024}/0001: the abstract body sits inside its own col-md-12 with no heading and no "Abstract" prefix, immediately followed by a second col-md-12 that only contains the keywords block.
